deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.desc: You can request deletion of your Hisabify account and all associated data at any time. This page explains how to do that and what happens to your data.

method1.title: Method 1 — Delete in the App (Recommended)
method1.desc: Instant deletion of all your financial data
method1.step1: Open the Hisabify app and sign in to your account.
method1.step2: Tap your profile avatar in the top-right corner of the dashboard.
method1.step3: Select Data & Privacy from the profile menu.
method1.step4: Scroll to the Danger Zone section and tap Delete Data.
method1.step5: Type DELETE in the confirmation box and tap Delete Data to confirm.
method1.note: Your financial data is deleted immediately. You will be signed out automatically.

method2.title: Method 2 — Request via Email
method2.desc: For full account removal including your login credentials
method2.step2: Use the subject line: Account Deletion Request — Hisabify
method2.step3: Include the email address associated with your Hisabify account in the message body.
method2.note: We will process your request within 30 days and send a confirmation to your email once complete.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.desc: In-app deletion removes your financial data immediately from our servers with no retention period. Login credential removal via email is processed within 30 days. Backups that include your data are purged within 90 days of the deletion request as part of our standard backup rotation schedule.

faq.a2: Use the add action from the bottom navigation, then choose manual entry, voice input, or receipt scan and save the transaction.
